The San Francisco Environment Department page, dated 03/21/2025, lists “6:00am to 3:00pm” and advises visitors to confirm hours with the individual market website. The event row’s time remains blank; all three official pages are linked so the discrepancy can be reviewed. Admission is not stated; free parking is not free entry.
